main_text.p: ciano præside Syriæ. ANTIOXEΩN ET ZIP anno 117 scilicet juxta tertiam æram, quam Cæsarianam vocant, atque pro epochâ habet annum U. C. 707; quâ Julius Cæsar libertatem à Pompejo concessam Antiochenis restituit, aut confirmavit; atque incidit in annum 822, Æ. V. 69. ab ejus autumno. Ita triplicem Antiochenorum æram evicimus.
main_text.head: APPENDIX SECUNDA.
CAPUT I.
Res & gesta Herodis sub J. Cæsare & Antonio.
main_text.p: §. 1.ANno P. J. 4667. U. C. 707 Caleno & Vatinio coss.

Devictâ Alexandriâ Antipater ob navatam Cæsari operam Judææ fuit præfectus, atque Hyrcanus in pontificatu aliisque dignitatibus confirmatus, cujus significem notans Antipater Phasaelum, filium suum natu majorem, ducem Judææ, Herodem, natu secundum, ducem Galilææ constituit, à quo in Syriam Cæsarem deduxerat. Erat tunc HE-

page.notes: The first word "ciano" is a fragment continuing from the previous page, and the paragraph is marked cont="true". A small bullet mark stands in the left margin beside the line with "annum 822"; it carries no text, so it is not transcribed as a note. The "Pompejo" line shows a stray quotation mark before the italic word, which I could not confirm, so it is omitted. The page is cut off at the foot after "formam", and the text continues on the missing part.
